description:
Menu contract — the actionable MENU archetype: DropdownMenu, ContextMenu,
Select, Autocomplete, and Menubar menus. One token set so every menu surface
reads the SAME item / popup treatment (spacing, radius, highlight,
destructive), consumed by the shared `.a63-Menu-*` recipe (including Select /
Autocomplete surfaces + items). The popup *surface* treatment (gel / bevel /
backdrop / elevation) comes from the OVERLAY contract — this contract only
adds the menu-specific item + chrome vocabulary.

── TWO tonal styles for the HIGHLIGHTED item (mirrors `segment`) ───────────
  1. neutral (default) — a quiet hover fill (--a63-surface-control-hover).
  2. primary           — the accent fill (the classic macOS menu highlight).
  Selected by a tone flag / theme default; the RESTING + destructive treatment
  is shared by both tones.

── AXIS TRAP (see selection.css) ──────────────────────────────────────────
  Colour hooks reference mode/theme/brand semantics, so they are NOT declared
  at :root (a var(--a63-action-*) resolved at :root freezes to the root mode).
  They are consumed at the recipe USE-SITE with the live-semantic fallback in
  the API block below, and a theme overrides them under [data-a63-theme].
  Only axis-independent geometry + treatment defaults live at :root here.

Menu spacing follows item shape. At the 'none' radius scale, rows become square
and the menu collapses to a flat, flush list: no inter-item gap and no popup
inset, so highlighted rows span edge-to-edge — the dense CRT / Win98 menu.
At every other radius scale (subtle/default/round), the inset/gapped rhythm is
restored for rounded highlights.

padding.$description: ── Popup box metrics (surface treatment = OVERLAY contract) ────────────

block.$description:
NOTE: --a63-menu-popup-radius and --a63-menu-item-radius are NOT declared
here. Radius is a THEME-VARYING axis (themes set --a63-overlay-radius /
--a63-control-radius), so declaring them at :root would freeze them to the
root (modern) value and inherit it into every theme — the same resolve-at-
declaration trap as the colour hooks. They are read at the recipe use-site:
  popup  -> var(--a63-menu-popup-radius, var(--a63-overlay-radius, --radius-lg))
  item   -> popup radius - popup border - popup padding (concentric inset)
A theme MAY set --a63-menu-*-radius under [data-a63-theme] to override.

gap.$description: icon <-> label gap WITHIN an item
